verdict.rationale: Fly.io is a cloud hosting platform, not an agent or AI assistant, so consuming tools from MCP servers is a category error for this kind of product. Its MCP evidence covers a different capability: hosting MCP servers on Machines or Sprites, an experimental flyctl MCP server, and a proxy entry added to other clients' configurations. None of this shows Fly.io itself plugging in MCP servers to use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
